drafted_from: tool:bring-an-effects-layer-to-a-reference-loudness row in tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/tool-rows.json, its script in tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/do-work/ and tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/test/test_judge_sound_effects.py (run for real on made-up tones)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Scale my variant palette /work/sfx/b by one gain so its effects track is as loud as the reference layer /work/sfx/a-layer.wav." It runs the leveler and reports the common gain.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads CUES.json, a variant palette folder and a reference layer on this computer and changes the palette's WAV files in place.
instructions: 1. Make the reference layer from the first palette with tool:place-sound-effect-cues-into-an-effects-layer (for example /work/sfx/a-layer.wav).
2. Have the variant palette folder (for example /work/sfx/b) and the same cues.json. It is changed in place, so keep a copy if you want the original.

3. Say "Level my variant to the reference". The AI reads the row with tools:list and runs: python3 -I tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/do-work/match_an_effects_layer_loudness.py /work/sfx/b /work/sfx/cues.json /work/sfx/a-layer.wav
4. Read the last line: layer_lufs_before, target_lufs and common_gain_db; the same numbers are saved in /work/sfx/b/level.json. Every sound moved by the one gain, so balance between sounds is kept.

worked_examples.title: A quiet variant palette is raised by 12.0 dB to match the reference layer
worked_examples.ask: Level my variant palette to the reference effects layer.
worked_examples.given: From tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/test/test_judge_sound_effects.py (test_a_variant_palette_gets_one_common_gain_to_the_reference_layers_loudness, run for real): variant b has hit.wav (210 Hz) and tick.wav (1900 Hz) at level 0.1, the reference a-layer.wav was made from level 0.4 sounds with the same cues. Command: python3 -I tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/do-work/match_an_effects_layer_loudness.py /work/sfx/b /work/sfx/cues.json /work/sfx/a-layer.wav
worked_examples.hands_back: Last line: {"result": {"layer_lufs_before": -25.9, "target_lufs": -13.9, "common_gain_db": 12.0}}, also written to /work/sfx/b/level.json. Placing the cues from b again then gives a layer at -13.9 LUFS, within 0.2 of the target.
